status: FROZEN BEFORE NATURAL STAGE-2 CANDIDATE OUTCOMES
scientific_question: Does example-conditional selection among identity, MN, SA, and WHOLE geometry provide positive utility on natural TallyQA counting examples beyond the strongest development-selected geometry-restricted router?

historical_ugr_source.policy: Mechanically reuse the historical UGR-v1 candidate semantics, 47-feature representation, candidate encoding, router model class, OOF procedure, tie-breaking, and restricted comparator rule.

development.allowed_use: Development only. May be used for natural Stage-2 candidate outcome generation, feature collection, grouped OOF router development, restricted comparator selection, and final router fitting.

semantics.MN: d_MN = normalize((h @ U4) @ U4.T); Delta h = gain * (selected_alpha - 1) * ||h||_2 * d_MN
semantics.SA: d_SA = normalize(Pg); Delta h = gain * (selected_alpha - 1) * ||h||_2 * d_SA
semantics.WHOLE: effective_alpha = 1 + gain * (selected_alpha - 1); multiply the full L18H13 slice by effective_alpha

sample_features.composition: 39 frozen natural Proposal Controller features + selected_alpha + selected_score + 6 mechanistic summaries

candidate_encoding.identity_reference: all nine candidate channels equal zero

cross_validation.policy: Reuse the exact historical UGR KFold/fold construction implementation. All 43 candidate rows from one natural sample must remain in the same fold.

rule: fewer OOF breaks if accuracy tied
smaller mean selected nonzero gain if still tied
restricted_comparator_selection.selection_timing: After development OOF results, before any Natural-UGR final cohort generation.

final_cohort.generation_timing: May be generated only after development candidate outcomes, natural Stage-2 feature archive, all three final router bundles, restricted comparator identity, and analysis implementation are frozen and committed.
final_cohort.selection_policy: Use the same TallyQA source eligibility and answer-validity rules as confirmation-v2, then deterministically select fresh examples after excluding every pre-F1 TallyQA question/image used by formal natural-domain AROMA experiments.
required_exclusions: zero question_id overlap with all pre-F1 formal TallyQA cohorts
zero image_id overlap with all pre-F1 formal TallyQA cohorts
zero pixel-SHA256 overlap with all pre-F1 formal TallyQA cohorts
final_cohort.collision_policy: If a deterministically selected candidate collides by image or pixel hash, reject it and take the next deterministic candidate under the frozen ordering.
final_cohort.realized_stage2_population: All and only final samples for which the unchanged frozen natural Stage-1 controller produces selected_alpha > 1.0.

primary_comparison.population: realized fresh final samples with selected_alpha > 1.0
primary_comparison.effect: unified accuracy minus restricted accuracy in percentage points

secondary_endpoints: composite full-cohort exact-count accuracy: retain frozen Stage-1 action on non-upward samples and use Stage-2 router choice on upward samples

interpretation_policy.statistically_supported_natural_transfer: unified-minus-restricted > 0, paired 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0, and exact McNemar p < 0.05
interpretation_policy.positive_but_uncertain_transfer: unified-minus-restricted > 0 and unified-only > restricted-only, but one or both conventional paired uncertainty criteria do not cross the prespecified threshold
interpretation_policy.scientific_scope: The primary hypothesis tests whether example-conditional geometry routing provides positive natural-domain utility. It does not require MN, SA, or WHOLE to be universally superior.

prohibited_after_f1: change router model class or C
change CV fold count or seed
change target final cohort size based on development candidate outcomes
